meta.description: Personal site — work, projects, games, and hobbies.

profile.name: Andrew Dai
profile.shortBio: I build software, play with side projects, and collect hobbies like postcards. This site is a loose scrapbook of all of that — meant for curious collaborators and future teammates.

landingCollage.body: Hi, I'm Andrew. Come in, look around, and treat this like a slightly over-organized scrapbook of work, games, projects, and the things I do away from a keyboard.

landingCollage.alt: Andrew sitting outside at a cafe
landingCollage.caption: Welcome in. This is the front door photo.

landingCollage.caption: A softer note from outside the work tabs.

landingCollage.body: I like interfaces that feel a little handmade: soft edges, visible texture, and navigation that feels like finding a note pinned to a photo.
